**Dr. Nzinga Cates, PhD, LCMHC, NCC**
Cates Counseling and Consulting, PLLC
Charlotte, North Carolina

**September 4, 2026**

**Hiring Committee**
**Re: Clinic Director – Adolescent Mental Health**

Dear Hiring Committee:

I am writing to express my interest in the Clinic Director – Adolescent Mental Health position. As a Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselor and National Certified Counselor with more than 25 years of behavioral health experience, I bring a strong combination of clinical leadership, adolescent mental health expertise, program oversight, and organizational management.

Throughout my career, I have worked extensively with adolescents and families experiencing complex behavioral, emotional, trauma-related, and family-system concerns. My background includes outpatient and community-based treatment, intensive in-home services, clinical supervision, treatment planning, crisis intervention, and coordination of care. These experiences have given me a strong understanding of both the clinical needs of adolescents and the importance of engaging families and multidisciplinary providers in effective treatment.

For more than a decade, I have also owned and operated Cates Counseling and Consulting, PLLC, where I am responsible for clinical operations, quality of care, ethical and regulatory compliance, program development, and organizational decision-making. This experience has strengthened my ability to balance excellent clinical care with the operational responsibilities required to lead a successful behavioral health program.

In addition to my clinical background, I hold a PhD in Forensic Psychology with a specialization in Victimology. My doctoral training further developed my expertise in trauma, adolescent behavior, family systems, victimization, and the factors that can contribute to behavioral and emotional difficulties among young people.

I am excited about the opportunity to return to a leadership role focused on adolescents while supporting clinicians in delivering high-quality, trauma-informed, evidence-based care. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my clinical experience, leadership skills, and commitment to young people and families to your organization.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to discussing how my experience can contribute to your team and the adolescents and families you serve.

Sincerely,

**Dr. Nzinga Cates, PhD, LCMHC, NCC**
Founder & Owner

position.name: Virtual Intake Coordinator - Adolescent PHP/IOP
position.description:
Virtual Intake Coordinator

Spanish Required | Remote in FL | Part-Time | $17/hour, $19/hour upon completion of training

About the Role
This is a virtual coordinator role supporting AWA's adolescent program with a focus on intakes and administrative support. You keep the program organized and moving by managing intake documentation, coordinating schedules, supporting virtual sessions, and communicating with families throughout the admissions process. Spanish fluency is required for this role.

Backgrounds that translate well: Psychology/Counseling Graduate Studies · Behavioral Health · Case Management · Education · Administrative Support

What You'll Do

  • Process intakes, upload sign-in sheets, prepare welcome kits, and maintain census records
  • Coordinate scheduling for new admissions, including psych and IEP appointments
  • Communicate with parents and families by phone and email in English and Spanish on intake logistics and progress updates
  • Monitor and redirect adolescent clients (ages 13–17) via chat during virtual group sessions and transitions
  • Provide real-time tech support to clients during virtual sessions (Zoom, breakout rooms, chat)
  • Track attendance and maintain accurate program records
  • Complete same-day documentation, including wellness check-ins as needed
  • Escalate safety concerns, disclosures, and behavioral flags to the clinical team immediately

What We're Looking For
Required

  • Bilingual required: English and Spanish
  • Experience in a clinical, educational, administrative, or community mental health setting
  • Comfortable supporting virtual group sessions and managing basic tech troubleshooting (Zoom, breakout rooms)
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Emotionally regulated, professional, and consistent under pressure
  • Understands the limits of a non-clinical role — escalates appropriately, never makes independent clinical decisions

AWA is an adolescent mental health organization operating PHP and IOP programs in South Florida. We exist to serve teens and families at their most critical moments — and this role is at the center of that work every day.

Learn More: Adolescent Wellness Academy

Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm excited to apply for the Medical Assistant position in Adolescent Wellness at Adolescent Wellness Academy.

For the past several years, I've worked at a clinic in Connecticut where I handled everything from call triage to EMR/EHR management, prior authorizations, coding, and day-to-day care coordination — across a patient base that included people of all ages, adults especially. That mix of work taught me a lot: how to stay calm and clear on the phone with someone who's worried, how to keep the administrative side running smoothly so nothing falls through the cracks, and how much of good care actually happens in the details most patients never see.

What draws me to adolescent wellness specifically is the balance it requires. Teenagers are often figuring out how to speak up for themselves in a healthcare setting for the first time, while parents still want to be kept in the loop. I've seen how much it matters to get that balance right — to make a young patient feel heard and respected, without leaving their family in the dark. It's a dynamic I found myself paying close attention to in my triage work, and it's part of why this role feels like a natural next step.

I'd love the chance to bring that same attention — to both the people and the process — to Adolescent Wellness Academy. Thank you for considering my application, and I'd welcome the opportunity to talk further.

Sincerely,
Ayesha Tahir

position.name: Virtual Creative Group Facilitator – Adolescent PHP/IOP
position.description:
VIRTUAL CREATIVE GROUP FACILITATOR – ADOLESCENT PHP/IOP

Remote | Independent Contractor | 2–3 Groups Weekly | [Schedule] | [Rate] per Group | Paid Biweekly via Invoice

ABOUT THE ROLE

Adolescent Wellness Academy (AWA) is seeking a master’s-level Creative Group Facilitator to lead engaging virtual groups for adolescents ages 13–17 in our PHP/IOP mental health program. Groups may incorporate art, music, movement, writing, mindfulness, or other creative activities.

Backgrounds that translate well: Art, Music, Expressive Arts, Creative Writing, Education, Recreation, and Counseling.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Facilitate 2–3 live virtual groups each week
• Create structured, age-appropriate activities
• Promote creativity, connection, and emotional expression
• Maintain engagement in a virtual group setting
• Complete attendance and required documentation

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

• Master’s degree in a creative, educational, or behavioral health field
• Group facilitation experience
• Experience working with adolescents ages 13–17
• Familiarity with PHP, IOP, or behavioral health settings
• Experience facilitating creative groups remotely
• Private home office, webcam, and reliable internet

Preferred:

• Adolescent PHP/IOP experience
• Trauma-informed or strengths-based experience
• Warm, creative, and dependable virtual presence

This is a fully remote independent contractor opportunity. Payment is issued biweekly upon invoice submission.

Adolescent Wellness Academy provides PHP and IOP mental health services for adolescents ages 13–17 across South Florida. We serve young people and their families during critical moments—and this role helps make that care engaging and meaningful.

Learn More: Adolescent Wellness Academy

Lead Mental Health Technician – Adolescents (Bilingual)

On-Site | Davie, FL | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM | $20–$22/hour

About the Role

Lead the Mental Health Technician team supporting adolescents ages 13–17 in a PHP/IOP behavioral health program. This hands-on role combines team supervision, client support, crisis de-escalation, documentation, and daily program coordination.

Relevant experience: Behavioral Health · Mental Health · Youth Services · Case Management · Education · Team Leadership

What You’ll Do

  • Supervise, train, and support the Mental Health Technician team
  • Coordinate daily schedules, assignments, and program coverage
  • Support client intakes, assessments, drug testing, groups, and psychiatric appointments
  • Observe client behavior and document concerns accurately
  • Provide emotional support while maintaining professional boundaries
  • Respond to crises using de-escalation and redirection techniques
  • Collaborate with therapists and clinical leadership
  • Complete incident reports and required documentation
  • Maintain facility safety, cleanliness, and Environment of Care compliance
  • Escalate clinical concerns appropriately

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Two or more years of behavioral health or mental health experience
  • Previous leadership, supervisory, or team-lead experience
  • Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish
  • Strong documentation and incident-reporting skills
  • Calm, professional, and emotionally regulated under pressure
  • Eligible for DCF and AHCA Level 2 background screening

Preferred

  • Experience working with adolescents
  • PHP, IOP, residential, or substance use treatment experience
  • High school diploma or GED

About AWA

Adolescent Wellness Academy provides PHP and IOP mental health treatment for adolescents ages 13–17 and their families across South Florida.

Learn more: Adolescent Wellness Academy

position.description:
Adolescent Mental Health Technician (Bilingual: English & Spanish)

On Site | Davie, FL | Part-Time | 830am-1130pm OR 3pm-8pm, Monday-Friday | Bilingual

Compensation: This role starts at $17.00/hour during the onboarding and training period. After successful completion of training and certification in core responsibilities, pay increases to $19.00/hour.

About the Role

Adolescent Wellness Academy (AWA) is hiring for our adolescent PHP (Partial Hospitalization Program) and IOP (Intensive Outpatient Program) in Davie, FL. 

You are the operational backbone of the AWA program environment. You ensure the day-to-day experience for adolescent clients is safe, structured, and therapeutically consistent — from the moment they arrive to the moment they leave. This role is hands-on, fast-paced, and client-facing, requiring calm under pressure and genuine investment in the teens you serve.

Backgrounds that translate well: Direct Care · Youth Counselor · Residential Counselor · Mental Health Technician · Psych Tech · Paraprofessional · Behavior Technician · Group Home · Youth Care Worker · Case Aide · Education · Community Services

What You'll Do

  • Supervise adolescent clients ages 13–17 during groups, sessions, transitions, breaks, and unstructured milieu time
  • Monitor and maintain program safety; respond to escalated behavior using trauma-informed care and crisis intervention protocols
  • De-escalate conflict and redirect behavior without power struggles
  • Support therapists and clinicians in maintaining therapeutic schedules and daily program flow
  • Greet and assist families at drop-off and pick-up with professionalism and warmth, in English and Spanish
  • Manage front desk responsibilities including phones, attendance, and client sign-in/sign-out
  • Complete accurate, same-day EMR documentation including wellness check-ins, behavioral observations, and incident reports
  • Escalate safety concerns, disclosures, and behavioral flags to the clinical team immediately and appropriately
  • Support program operations with light administrative and organizational tasks

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 1–2 years of adolescent experience in a school, clinical, behavioral health, camp, residential, or community setting
  • Demonstrated ability to de-escalate, regulate, and maintain structure without power struggles
  • Strong documentation and incident reporting skills
  • Emotionally regulated, professional, and consistent under pressure
  • Understands the limits of a non-clinical role — escalates appropriately, never makes independent clinical decisions
  • Bilingual: fluent Spanish and English
  • Must pass a Level 2 background screening and pre-employment drug screen
  • Reliable transportation to our Davie, FL location

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in psychology, social work, human services, education, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered
  • CPI, MANDT, or NCI crisis prevention training
  • Prior experience in an outpatient or residential mental health setting
  • Familiarity with EMR/EHR documentation

AWA is an adolescent mental health organization operating PHP and IOP programs in South Florida. We exist to serve teens and families at their most critical moments — and this role is at the center of that work every day.

Learn More: Adolescent Wellness Academy
